forms: first n primes (p_1=2, ..., p_n) are 13th power residues mod p
leg1_engine: device stream (sieve, 4^j == 1 mod p, run by Montgomery powers); p proved prime by deterministic Miller-Rabin; run re-read with plain integer arithmetic
leg2_independent: sympy isprime; the oracle's run; an explicit root for each of the first 9 primes, the symbol of the next, and a Lucas certificate for p, each checked
leg3_rederivation: device re-sweep of 2879 candidates ending past p at another alignment with a 64-prime sieve: p is first of run >= 9; CPU engine = device on the 16384 candidates around p at floor 1 (84 primes)
roots_note: x with x^13 == q (mod p) for each of the first 9 primes q

stopper.note: 29^((p-1)/13) mod p; not 1, so 29 is not a residue

least_claim.basis: every integer 2*13*j + 1 below p -- which includes every prime of which the power divides p - 1 -- was taken in order by this campaign from j = 1: dropped as composite on a small prime factor or on 2^((N-1)/13) != 1 (mod N), or as a prime of which 2 is not a residue by the same test, or read to its run, which was below 9
least_claim.conditional_on: nothing (Euler's criterion; Fermat's little theorem for the compositeness test)
least_claim.canaries: a(1)..a(8) rediscovered in order by this campaign
